name: sqltool
description: 数据库管理工具，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite、TDSQL等数据库

author.company: 北京先进数通信息技术股份公司
author.name: 木木木主

scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run verify:production
scripts.build:renderer: npm run clean:renderer && node node_modules/vite/dist/node/cli.js build
scripts.test:connection-lifecycle: npm run build:main && node scripts/testConnectionLifecycle.cjs && node scripts/testConnectionLostClose.cjs
scripts.test:database-creation: npm run build && node scripts/testDatabaseCreation.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseEncodingCatalog.cjs
scripts.test:database-menu: npm run build:main && node scripts/testDatabaseContextMenu.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseManagement.cjs
scripts.test:database-backup: npm run build:main && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupNaming.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupParser.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupObjects.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupSqlGeneration.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupTableReader.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupLifecycle.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseBackupFailure.cjs
scripts.test:table-features: npm run build:main && node scripts/testTableFeatures.cjs && node scripts/testTableTransferFormats.cjs && node scripts/testTableTransferModel.cjs && node scripts/testTableDataTypes.cjs && node scripts/testTableDesignerSubmitLog.cjs
scripts.test:database-tools: npm run build:main && node scripts/testDatabaseTools.cjs && node scripts/testDatabaseToolExecution.cjs && node scripts/testStructureSyncExecution.cjs && node scripts/testStructureSyncSafety.cjs
